claims: SpaceX successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites via Falcon 9 from Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, on April 6, 2026.
25 Starlink satellites were launched to orbit from SLC-4E at Vandenberg on April 6, 2026.
29 Starlink satellites were launched from Cape Canaveral on April 2, 2026.
EchoStar XXV mission was launched from Cape Canaveral on March 10, 2026.
A Falcon 9 is scheduled to launch a Northrop Grumman Cygnus cargo spacecraft to the ISS.
Falcon 9 is a reusable two-stage rocket for transporting humans and payloads to Earth orbit and beyond.
Falcon 9 has achieved hundreds of successful missions.
The first stage of Falcon 9 returns to Earth, landing on a droneship like "A Shortfall of Gravitas" or a designated landing zone.
The second stage of Falcon 9 carries the payload to its destination.
Falcon 9 is primarily used for launching Starlink satellites, commercial payloads, and crew/cargo missions to the International Space Station.
Recent launches from California have been visible across Southern California skies.
